title: Hom of the telescope comparison is isomorphic to the ordinary-limit Roos arrow
statement: Let O be a commutative ring sheaf on a small site, E a sequential diagram of ordinary complexes, I any coefficient complex, and X a complex of inverse towers. Given a natural isomorphism e:E.op ⋙ Hom(-,I) ≅ X.asFunctor, and f:Cone(1-shift on the direct sum of E)→colim E whose unshifted restriction is telescopeToColimit and whose shifted cochain restriction is zero, the arrow Hom(f,I) is isomorphic in the arrow category to the actual zero-second-coordinate arrow ExactProductsRoos.comparison.app X. Neither K-injectivity nor a quasi-isomorphism hypothesis or conclusion occurs.

proof.text: Apply ringedHomComplexColimitCone_isLimit and postcompose by the specified tower isomorphism e. The termwise ordinary-limit cone of X is limiting by HomologicalComplex.isLimitOfEval. Their unique cone-point isomorphism a identifies every colimit-leg restriction with the corresponding ordinary-limit projection.

InternalHomCoproductFanIsLimit applied to the evaluation of the coproduct cofan, followed by commuting the two product universal properties, makes Hom(S,I) the product of Hom(E_n,I). Transport the factors by e to obtain b:Hom(S,I) ≅ product(X), with its projection equations. Additivity and functoriality of Hom, checked with the recorded Hom projections, identify precomposition by telescopeColimitShift with the Roos difference by evaluation at each product projection.

Reuse the proved first-Hom coordinate lemmas in SignedDoubleHomCone.Calculation: inB/outB and inA/outA are inverse graded decompositions, and inB_d/inA_d give their differentials. In degree n multiply outA by n.negOnePow. The inverse is the sum of inB and n.negOnePow times inA. The binary cone identities prove the inverse equations; the two differential formulas and negOnePow_succ prove the chain-map equation. This gives Hom(Cone(u),I) ≅ mappingCocone(-Hom(u,I)). Transport along the arrow isomorphism with both legs b to get the required target isomorphism.

Check the arrow square on the two raw cone projections. On the first, hf₁ and contravariant functoriality give precomposition by telescopeToColimit; testing at each product projection identifies it with a followed by inclusion. On the second, evaluate hf₂ in each source degree and use the Hom projection formula: precomposition followed by outA is zero. The specified Roos comparison has first coordinate inclusion and second coordinate zero by comparisonApp_f. Cone projection extensionality completes Arrow.isoMk.

mathlib_searches.query: Finite free Koszul complex dual tensor evaluation isomorphism natural in the differential and chain maps
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits about Kaehler differentials and finite dimensional evaluation. No theorem for the actual sheaf Koszul tower. Loogle CochainComplex.mappingCocone finds constructors and coordinate projection identities, but no Hom-of-telescope comparison.

Mathlib has no complex Koszul construction. Source HomComplexMappingCone concerns the second variable. SignedDoubleHomCone has proved private coordinate and differential formulas relevant to the first-variable calculation. InternalHomCoproduct supplies a sheaf-level universal property. RingedKoszulColimitHomOrdinaryLimit only asserts a limit isomorphism with a unit equation, not a tower evaluation isomorphism or the telescope map normalization. Blueprint Koszul search finds no duplicate of either precise algebraic step.

theorem telescopeHom_roos_arrow_iso
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (E : ℕ ⥤ ringedSiteComplex O)
    (I : ringedSiteComplex O)
    (X : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)) ℤ)
    (e : E.op ⋙ (homComplexFunctor (R := O)).flip.obj I ≅ X.asFunctor)
    (f : CochainComplex.mappingCone (CochainComplex.telescopeColimitShift O E) ⟶
      colimit E)
    (hf₁ : CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr (CochainComplex.telescopeColimitShift O E) ≫
      f = CochainComplex.telescopeToColimit O E)
    (hf₂ : (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl (CochainComplex.telescopeColimitShift O E)).comp
      (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom f) (add_zero _) = 0) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk (((homComplexFunctor (R := O)).map f.op).app I) ≅
      Arrow.mk (ExactProductsRoos.comparison.app X))
